 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hlines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
              if row and row[0] != bg and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w)
              if grid[0][c] != bg and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + hlines + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vlines + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ci in range(len(cbounds) - 1):
        c0, c1 = cbounds[ci] + 1, cbounds[ci + 1]
        bands = []
        for ri in range(len(rbounds) - 1):
            r0, r1 = rbounds[ri] + 1, rbounds[ri + 1]
            bands.append((r0, r1, any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))))
        sources = [(a, b) for a, b, has in bands if has]
        if not sources:
            continue
        # Copy the occupied template into empty horizontal bands of matching size.
        src0, src1 = sources[0]
        for r0, r1, has in bands:
            if has or r1 - r0 != src1 - src0:
                continue
            for dr in range(r1 - r0):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r0 + dr][c] = grid[src0 + dr][c]
    return out

 "path": "programs/task-a36e1a42.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hlines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
              if row[0] != bg and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w)
              if grid[0][c] != bg and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + hlines + [h]
    cb = [-1] + vlines + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            cells = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c])
                     for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)
                     if grid[r][c] != bg]
            regions.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,cells))
    # The unique decorated compartment is the template; duplicate its colored
    # cells at the same relative positions in every same-sized compartment.
    src = max(regions, key=lambda x: len(x[4]))
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1,pattern = src
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1,_ in regions:
        if r1-r0 != sr1-sr0 or c1-c0 != sc1-sc0:
            continue
        for dr,dc,color in pattern:
            out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = color
    return out
"
}
